title: CLAUDE.md
text: zucrypt one package zu* family (siblings checked alongside : zuxlsx, zuxml, zukomp, zuhttp, …). boundary strict main thing preserve: zucrypt owns cryptographic primitives — hashes, HMAC, AES-CBC/ECB, constant-time compare, secure cleanup. must never acquire XML, ZIP, Office, socket TLS dependencies. Office/Excel decryption orchestration lives zuxlsx, . Office adapter owns iteration counts, salts, block keys, password verifiers segment IVs; may depend zucrypt zuxml, never reverse. zuhttp owns TLS trust, keeps native OS TLS backend. Mbed TLS separate, optional backend, something zucrypt provides. Two interfaces exposed: small R surface: crypto_info(), hash_raw(), hmac_raw(), constant_time_equal(), aes_cbc_encrypt_raw() / aes_cbc_decrypt_raw(). versioned C ABI: public header inst/include/zucrypt.h plus one accessor registered R_RegisterCCallable, returning table function pointers opaque context handles. Consumers use LinkingTo: zucrypt + Imports: zucrypt resolve via R_GetCCallable. Upstream Mbed/PSA types must never appear header. backend vendored, pinned Mbed TLS 4.x / TF-PSA-Crypto crypto subset (TLS, X.509). Installation must download sources require Python/Perl generate , upstream symbols must hidden namespaced independent vendored copies bind .

title: CLAUDE.md
text: Binary arguments raw vectors . character value never interpreted filename, password byte sequence. Algorithm names exact scalars — partial matching, fallback. AES wrappers add/strip padding authentication; keys must 16/24/32 bytes, IVs exactly 16, data multiple 16. Authentication caller’s responsibility. SHA-1 AES-ECB exist purely Office compatibility never defaults new formats. encrypt_file(password = ), PBKDF2/HKDF/AEAD/RNG initial scope — needs concrete consumer first. future randomness uses platform entropy seeded backend RNG, never R’s RNG. Errors R conditions inheriting zucrypt_error stable code; never attach keys, passwords plaintext condition. C functions return status codes never raise R errors, allocate R objects call back R. API resolution calls main-thread 0.1. Testing gate: published known-answer vectors per algorithm, one-shot vs incremental equivalence, independent-implementation compatibility — self round trip explicitly sufficient. Tests must run offline synthetic fixtures.
